channel.title: Cubesia patches
channel.description: Patch notes of the Cubesia Minecraft server.

item.title: Update #3
item.description:
• Added a Mining competition.
  • Added chat colors.
  • Added custom (non-vanilla) advancements.
  • Added player levels.
  • Added collections.
  • Added the ability to change spawner mob types using spawn eggs.
  • Added an Overworld map.
  • Added a Halloween week calendar.
  • Added voting rewards.
  • Added a black market for purchasing various vanilla items.
  • Added casino-style "Treasure" features (under cosmetics).
  • Added redeem code.
  • Added cosmetics (purchasable via /shop).
  • Added the ability to purchase sell wands.
  • Added the ability to purchase flight time.
  • Added the ability to purchase keys.
  • Change "NoTrample" mechanics.
  • Change all item prices.
  • Fixed minor bugs.
  • Removed unnecessary messages when receiving money.
  • Removed all "vanilla" items from /shop.
  • Removed color codes for anvils and signs.

item.title: Patch #20
item.description:
• Added a 10% tax when listing an item in /ah and /order.
  • Fixed the Discord NPC skin.
  • Fixed some issues with crates.

item.title: Patch #19
item.description:
• Change chatgames rewards.
  • Change crates (all redesigned and improved).

item.title: Patch #18
item.description:
• Added a new economy system.
  • Added new blocks to the /sell command.
  • Change the /spawn cooldown from 30 seconds to 10 seconds.
  • Fixed enchantment levels for vanilla enchantments (max level based on the specific enchantment).
  • Fixed the "Too Expensive" issue that was still occurring.
  • Removed the visible /nightvision command.
  • Removed alerts during "fishing contests."

item.title: Patch #17
item.description:
• Added the /pw 'warp' command (previously /pw warp 'warp').
  • Change the maximum level for vanilla enchantments to 10.
  • Change the cost of combining high-level enchantments.
  • Fixed the malfunctioning string dupe glitch.
  • Fixed issues with fishing competitions regarding fish and rarity.
  • Removed the item stacking system.

item.title: Patch #16
item.description:
• Added wood and poplar to the Lumberjack profession.
  • Added the ability to obtain enchantments higher than the standard limit.
  • Added the fix where the 'Too expensive' message no longer appears.
  • Change the RTP cooldown (5 minutes -> 1 minute).
  • Fixed an issue where mobs could not pick up items.
  • Fixed the rank organization in the TAB list.

item.title: Update #2
item.description:
• New host: RealisticNode !
  • Added support for versions ranging from 1.21.8 to 26.3.
  • Added the ability to use bone meal on flowers, cacti, and sugar cane.
  • Added the ability to leash all passive (including villagers), hostile, and aquatic mobs.
  • Added the fact that bees no longer attack you after their hive is destroyed.
  • Added new death messages.
  • Added string duplication system (like before version 1.21.1).
  • Added leaderboards.
  • Added item stacking system to prevent lag.
  • Added teams.
  • Added in-game server changelog.
  • Added inventory backup system.
  • Added chat games featuring questions, equations, and more.
  • Added flight with a time-based system.
  • Change order system.
  • Change bounty system.
  • Change homes system.
  • Removed bank system.
  • Removed minions.

item.title: Patch #15
item.description:
• Added support for '&' color codes on signs, in anvils, and in chat.
  • Change the server version to Minecraft 26.2.
  • Change the enchantment table's storage so it now retains the lapis lazuli when the player closes the interface.
  • Change cauldrons so they no longer lose water when turning concrete powder into concrete.
  • Change to the utility of the Golden Dandelion.
  •   – Turns a baby into an adult (right-click).
  •   – Turns an adult into a baby (right-click).
  •   – Works on Villagers and all zombie variants.
  • Removed the /mechanics command.
  • Removed the item stacking system.

item.title: Patch #14
item.description:
• Added a plugin that allows opening players' inventories and Ender Chests.
  • Change items featuring old enchantments that were causing server lag.
  • Fixed the skin for the /pv NPC.
  • Removed the old status bars displayed above furnaces.

item.title: Patch #13
item.description:
• Added a gold ingot to the bottom right of the /sell menu; it opens the /sellprice view.
  • Change the value format from x.xx$ to x.xx$/u (so that items stack normally).

item.title: Update #1
item.description:
• Added a new command system.
  • Added PlayerWarps (/pw).
  • Added /trade "player".
  • Added /rewards.
  • Added /orders.
  • Added /ah.
  • Added a search system to /sellprice.
  • Added a new spawn area.
  • Added NPCs.
  • Change the enchantment system.
  • Change the scoreboard.
  • Change bank mechanics (interest, capacity, etc.).
  • Change /help to open a GUI.
  • Change the crate mechanics.
  • Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor would reset to the center after clicking in /shop, /sellprice and /settings.
  • Fixed negative permissions.
  • Removed bank messages.
  • Removed mob levels.
  • Removed "welcome" and "players online" messages (to reduce chat clutter upon connection).

item.title: Patch #12
item.description:
• Added automatic updates for selected plugins.
  • Added improved services for administrators.
  • Fixed permissions issue for operators.
  • Fixed numerous bugs affecting administrators.

item.title: Patch #11
item.description:
• Change mob health.
  • Change mob knockback resistance.
  • Change mob speed.
  • Change mob tracking range.
  • Removed progress bar for the brewing stand.
  • Removed progress bar for the composter.
  • Removed bee and honey counters for bee nests and beehives.
  • Removed progress bars for the smoker and blast furnace.
  • Removed progress bars for the campfire and soul campfire.
  • Removed progress bar system for cooking items in the furnace.

item.title: Patch #10
item.description:
• Added dirt_path as a block obtainable with Silk Touch.
  • Change mob speed.
  • Change the shards awarded by the AFK Zone.

item.title: Patch #9
item.description:
• Added a gold ingot to the bottom-right corner of the /sell interface to indicate the /sellprice command.
  • Added a progress bar for the brewing stand.
  • Added a progress bar for the composter.
  • Added bee and honey counters for bee nests and beehives.
  • Added progress bars for the smoker and blast furnace.
  • Added progress bars for the campfire and soul campfire.
  • Fixed an issue where the minion charge could be free.

item.title: Patch #8
item.description:
• Added a progress bar system for cooking items in the furnace.
  • Change the levels of passive mobs, which were almost always set to 10.

item.title: Patch #7
item.description: • Fixed the Hammer enchantment with Efficiency VI, which wasn't breaking blocks correctly.

item.title: Patch #6
item.description:
• Added /help and /helpall commands, allowing you to view all available server commands (either page by page or all at once).
  • Added items to the Amethyst crate.
  • Added items to the Foot crate.
  • Change in the /shop.
  • Change spawner prices for the "sellall" command.
  • Change the glass pane colors depending on the crate.

item.title: Patch #5
item.description:
• Added /settings – opens a GUI to toggle certain features.
  • Added /website.
  • Added items to the Sapphire crate.
  • Added items to the Crimson crate.
  • Change overall mob levels.
  • Change mob levels near spawn.
  • Change mob speeds.
  • Change /sell prices.
  • Fixed the commands marked in red.
  • Removed the /mechanics command.

item.title: Patch #4
item.description:
• Change mob level calculation method.
  • Change the maximum mob level (100 -> 50).
  • Change level colors.
  • Change maximum levels for passive mobs.
  • Change sell values (to avoid figures like 0.224).
  • Fixed mob levels that could change after spawning.

item.title: Patch #3
item.description:
• Added a reinforcement system to summon allies (for zombies only).
  • Change arrow damage dealt by mobs based on their level.
  • Change damage dealt by Creepers based on their level.
  • Change item drops from mobs based on their level.
  • Change XP drops from mobs based on their level.
  • Change player detection by mobs based on their level.
  • Change knockback dealt by mobs based on their level.
  • Change knockback resistance for mobs based on their level.
  • Change AFK zone reward (~378/h -> ~750/h).
  • Change the English translation of the wiki and rules messages.
  • Fixed the missing /banktop permission.
  • Fixed drops for silverfish and villager spawners.
  • Fixed the damage taken by the player, which was too high.
  • Removed the automatic voting message.

item.title: Patch #2
item.description:
• Added the /sellprice command – allows you to view the prices of all items.
  • Fixed messages regarding minion charges, as well as the interface for the various minions.

item.title: Patch #1
item.description:
• Change the fish selling prices in /sellfish.
  • Fixed the French translation that was showing in the TAB list when it shouldn't.
  • Fixed the /paytoggle command, which also affected other players.
  • Fixed the /pay command, which was inaccessible.
  • Fixed the /money top and /shards top commands, which were bugged (returning no data).
  • Fixed the /sellguiprice command, which was being displayed when it shouldn't have been.
  • Fixed the /banktop not appearing in the command list.
  • Fixed the /afk command that wasn't working.
  • Fixed Creepers not dealing damage.
